title: Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Offline Reinforcement Learning with Online Action Selection Enabled by Sparse Gaussian-Process Critics
abstract: arXiv:2611.14374v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Start-ups and grade changes remain largely operator-driven, while developing and maintaining dynamic models for model-based control requires substantial engineering effort. Hybrid Offline Learning and Online Optimisation (HOFLON) uses one-step offline reinforcement learning to select actions from historical transition data. In its original implementation, the online objective combines the predicted return from a tree-ensemble critic with an adversarial-autoencoder (AAE) penalty for unfamiliar state-action pairs. We examine the effect of this penalty and replace the critic and AAE with a sparse variational Gaussian-process (sGP) critic. Actions maximise $\mu - \kappa\sigma$, an uncertainty-adjusted estimate of the return from one action followed by the historical operating practice. On the HOFLON polymerisation-reactor benchmark, removing the AAE from HOFLON led to 4 failed start-ups in 15 runs over five critics. At its published weight,

translated_title: 基于稀疏高斯过程评论家实现在线动作选择的不确定性感知混合离线强化学习
translated_abstract: 开车启动和牌号切换在很大程度上仍依赖操作员手动驱动，而基于模型的控制方法需要开发和维护动态模型，这需要大量的工程投入。混合离线学习与在线优化（HOFLON）利用一步式离线强化学习从历史转移数据中选择动作。在其原始实现中，在线目标函数将树集成评论家预测的回报与针对不熟悉状态-动作对的对抗自编码器（AAE）惩罚相结合。我们考察了该惩罚项的作用，并用稀疏变分高斯过程（sGP）评论家替代了原来的评论家和AAE。动作选择旨在最大化 μ - κσ，即对“执行一个动作后遵循历史操作实践”所得回报的不确定性调整估计。在HOFLON聚合反应器基准测试中，从HOFLON中移除AAE导致在五个评论家的15次运行中出现4次启动失败。在其已发布的权重下，
tldr: 本文提出用稀疏变分高斯过程评论家同时替代树集成评论家与对抗自编码器惩罚，通过最大化不确定性调整的回报估计 μ-κσ，在混合离线强化学习框架HOFLON中实现不确定性感知的在线动作选择，提升了聚合反应器开车启动等任务的安全性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper replaces the tree-ensemble critic and adversarial-autoencoder penalty in HOFLON with a sparse variational Gaussian-process critic, enabling uncertainty-aware online action selection by maximizing the uncertainty-adjusted return estimate μ−κσ for safer and more reliable process operations such as polymerization reactor start-ups.
